notes.title: 0.3.1 Demo Update
notes.notes:
It's been about 3 months since we opened the demo build on March 19th. During this time, 1,600 players have played the demo through our Steam page and PlayX4 event. We're grateful to have received a lot of feedback, and based on all the feedback we've gathered, we've decided to update the demo once more.

The combat system has been comprehensively added to and improved, and a new mini dungeon has been added. The overall mood of the map has also been improved to create Graytail's unique atmosphere.

Combat Improvements
We received a lot of feedback that combat was monotonous, so we added and improved systems to make combat more dynamic.
In the previous demo, enemies would simply follow the player in a line, making them easy to deal with. In the update, we've modified enemies to surround the protagonist. Also, enemies used to have their attacks canceled when hit, but now once they start an attack, it continues even if they get hit.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/4d10b2a44a454186eaa8b87467187d8fcb051815.gif

In return, other features have been added for the player as well. First is lock-on. When you target an enemy with lock-on, the player character will face the targeted enemy regardless of which direction they move. This makes attacking easier since you don't need to manually turn directions for each attack. We've also added a parrying technique that deflects incoming enemy projectiles. You just need to swing your staff with the right timing.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/282931941153bc6b3b2469cda9373dfe6e750e15.gif

We've also refined the existing auto-targeting system. While it's basically non-targeted by default, we've modified the targeting rules to provide only slight correction limited to enemies in the player's direction of movement.

New Mini Dungeon
We received a lot of feedback that tension dropped at the beginning of the game because too much of the game's direction was concentrated in the early stages. So we've placed a small mini dungeon that provides about 10 minutes of gameplay after landing on the island, where players can learn the combat system mentioned above and experience the fun of puzzle gameplay.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/1b8b3ede040e8cc4f3478294795bc7e9d547f1aa.gif

Mood Improvements
We've worked on improving the overall mood of the game so that our game's identity can be felt just from looking at screenshots, while maintaining the pixel art aesthetic.

First, the game's lighting has been improved. We've made this world feel more vibrant through effects like flowing clouds, sunbeams, and leaf shadows.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/dd8525e253492a8ea2ca0297f7ac7ec3941a5b82.gif

The village has been enhanced with broken cars and modern street lamps that fit the story. The protagonist's house has changed from a log cabin to a cool caravan that suits exploration. The chickens in the village, which couldn't be interacted with in the previous demo, can now be caught and thrown or used for gliding.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/8b27dac2265aec9c9c0036c6336db79f70e60e6d.gif

The atmosphere of the dungeons has also changed. The entrance to the mangrove area dungeon has been modified to feel more like a forgotten temple. The laboratory placed within the dungeon has also been enlarged compared to before, with new objects added.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/7839eafe285a3092c87d1f3a38f223067084db37.gif

Other Improvements
Area names now display when moving to major locations. We've also fixed awkward dialogues throughout the game. Many minor bugs have been fixed as well.

Development and Release Plans
As we have been doing so far, we plan to continue working hard on Graytail until completion.
We're changing our release approach from going through Early Access to releasing the complete game all at once. Since it's a story game, we feel that having it cut off in the middle wouldn't be a good experience. This means the time to introduce the game to you will be pushed back a bit. We expect to need about another year of work.

We apologize for the delay in the game's release.

We'll prepare well and meet you with a perfect version.

notes.title: PlayX4 Showcase & New Demo Update Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! This is SyntaxFossil and PixelRoseBud!
Graytail will be participating in 2025 PlayX4! Visitors will be the first to try out our new areas and puzzles we've been working on. We'll refine these puzzles based on your feedback at PlayX4 before adding them to future demo builds.

Finding Us at PlayX4
You can check out Graytail at two locations during the event:

 Indie Game Room (Booth E10)
 2025 Gyeonggi Game Audition Winners' Showcase

We'll be there from May 22nd to 25th. Come by and give the game a try!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/5afca8ab88e6f8eaa52cbf69e5a018530d373747.png

Visual Enhancements
We've enhanced the game's atmosphere for better immersion. You'll now see drifting cloud shadows on the beach and gentle leaf shadows moving through the forest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/f67bff12a48f1e9555d183bc8fb0177d5368d413.png

Combat Updates
Based on your feedback about combat, we've implemented two new features:

 Target Lock: Now you can lock onto specific enemies during combat for more precise attacks and dodges.
 Ranged Parrying: Time your defenses right to deflect enemy projectiles - useful for defeating enemies or solving puzzles!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/5bd7b66e84500bf6796f5ede506f1ada96a9da3a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/09e6f9a143ce9dcff7cb86125a27daf1803e6860.png

We've also improved the enemy AI so multiple enemies will surround the player instead of just following in a line. Plus, once enemies begin an attack, your hits won't interrupt them anymore - so be strategic!

New Area: Lighthouse
We've added a lighthouse between the island's beach and village. Beneath it lies an underground cave featuring an engaging combat tutorial and glimpses into the game's lore.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/8b112e0659fe497eb3b0d99c309e2dfff741bfb0.png

Demo Update Preview
After PlayX4, we plan to release an updated demo in June incorporating your feedback. We're adding early-game content that might change some of the later sections, so if you haven't played the demo yet, definitely check it out after the update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/46e9a891f3c9f8d1d1cf86ee960f57c00b805b5d.png

Adding us to your wishlist and following our progress really helps us as indie developers. Thanks for supporting our team and stay tuned for more development updates!

notes.title: Demo Version 0.2.3 Update
notes.notes:
The following changes have been made. Thank you so much for your gameplay and feedback.

Language Pack Updates

 Awkward Japanese text has been corrected. Special thanks to place_b for their help.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where names weren't being properly entered on Japanese keyboards.
 Resolved situations where players could get trapped in dungeons.
 Fixed a problem where the left and right sides of the screen were cut off on certain monitor ratios.


Improvements

 Added a setting to manually limit frame rate.
 Dialogues without choices now advance more quickly.
 Enhanced hit effects for greater emphasis.
 Players now become briefly invincible for a short time after taking damage.
